parent_objective: design role-specific metric scorecard over existing bounded-panel artifacts
blocked_by: M1780 pivots away from global success ranking toward role-specific metric interpretation
supersedes: direct profile ranking from M1777 global success rate

public_gates: M1781 must define role-specific score fields and admissibility gates before score extraction
M1781 must use existing M1777/M1779 artifacts only and must not rerun reset or rollout
M1781 must keep profile ranking blocked unless a later audit admits it
M1781 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles or claim paper-level evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs role-specific metric interpretation after M1780 pivot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: scorecard design only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if a role cannot be assigned a defensible primary and guardrail metric
stop if design collapses mitigation and avoidance into one success metric
stop if design admits ranking before extraction and audit
fallback_plan: route to role-specific scorecard extraction if design is complete
route to metric-contract repair if role metrics remain ambiguous
route to branch stop if no defensible scorecard can be defined
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1780 pivots to role-specific scorecard branch

admission_evidence: M1780 synthesizes M1770-M1779 and pivots to role-specific metric scorecards
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1781 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for no-rollout scorecard extraction or metric repair
next_stage_criteria: each role has primary metrics and guardrails

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; scorecard design covers task-quality metrics, not history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Any later scorecard extraction must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L2 history-window, L3-online, and L3-reset controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If role-specific metrics remain ambiguous, route to metric-contract repair or stop rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A role-specific scorecard can be designed from M1777/M1779 evidence before extraction or ranking.
success_criteria: design defines metrics for stable avoidance AES drift recovery hidden dynamics robustness and unavoidable mitigation
design lists admissibility gates and ranking blockers
design preserves no-reset no-rollout no-training no-ranking and no-paper-claim guardrails
failure_criteria: design uses one global success metric for all roles
design ranks profiles or claims paper-level evidence

commands.name: design
commands.command: write role-specific metric scorecard design without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1781 passes if it defines a complete role-specific scorecard design without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
